title: Reproducibility archive for two agricultural-tractor virtual-prototype studies
description:
Source code, declared virtual-model inputs, reproduction scripts, result JSON files, figures, and English manuscript sources for two theoretical simulation studies: electrohydraulic tractor-hitch position holding and strictly causal hybrid-tractor energy-management benchmarking.

All evidence is conditional on declared virtual models. The archive contains no field, vehicle, bench, or calibrated component-map measurements.
